extrapolation.assumptions: Single-point scenario, not a fitted performance curve: assumed 26.5 t propellant, 3.4 t effective inert mass, 4.334 km/s exhaust velocity. Upper-stage parameters follow the comparison table in Upper Stage Liquid Propellant Rocket Engine: A Case Analysis; configuration and losses are not independently validated.
extrapolation.note: Extrapolated engineering estimate. Source samples remain unchanged; not a provider guarantee. Zero means this model predicts no positive delivered payload, not a certified impossibility. No extrapolation beyond C3=200.

vehicles.ground_rules: RoLaMGAS model estimate, not published positive-C3 performance or a provider guarantee. Calibrated to approximate readings of NSIL November 2025 brochure p.5, 170 km perigee, launch azimuth 107°, argument of perigee 178°. All source points have negative C3; 0–30 km²/s² is extrapolated. Effective upper-stage model assumes 28 t propellant and 4.334 km/s exhaust speed; velocity offset and effective inert mass are fitted, not measured. Brochure configuration upgrades, reserves, adapters, declination and ascent losses are not independently resolved. Rounded to 100 kg; uncertainty grows with C3. Do not use as a hard feasibility or payload guarantee. No extension beyond C3=30.

extrapolation.assumptions: Extends the same NSIL-calibrated effective C25 model; all original source observations have negative C3. Model output is clipped at zero payload.
extrapolation.note: Extrapolated engineering estimate. Source samples remain unchanged; not a provider guarantee. Zero means this model predicts no positive delivered payload, not a certified impossibility. No extrapolation beyond C3=200.

vehicles.ground_rules: Ariane 6 User's Manual, Issue 2 Revision 0 (February 2021), section 2.4.5, printed p.2-11. V-infinity=2.5 km/s, hence C3=6.25; free declination. Section 2.2 defines payload mass including the adapter/dispenser and any carrying structure. Disposal strategy may require mission-specific optimization. This is one published point, not a full curve or a rating for later booster upgrades. No extrapolation.

extrapolation.assumptions: Single-point scenario: 30 t upper-stage propellant is published by ESA; 4.5 t effective inert mass and 4.5 km/s effective exhaust velocity are explicitly analyst assumptions, not manufacturer ratings. extrapolation.note: Extrapolated engineering estimate. Source samples remain unchanged; not a provider guarantee. Zero means this model predicts no positive delivered payload, not a certified impossibility. No extrapolation beyond C3=200.

vehicles.adapter: Assumed extra 100 kg kick-stage integration hardware
vehicles.ground_rules: Conceptual configuration, not an offered or qualified launch service. Uses only interpolated published parent-launcher samples (no parent extrapolation), optimizes their staging C3, and subtracts the 2,171 kg motor plus an assumed 100 kg integration allowance. Northrop Minotaur IV/V/VI guide PDF p.23 gives 2,014 kg propellant and 157 kg inert motor mass; NASA 20240015535 Table 1 gives effective Isp 292.1 s. Assumes a tangential kick at 200 km Earth altitude and an analyst-selected 100 m/s loss allowance; no finite-burn, structural, attitude, separation, thermal, restart or integration qualification is modeled. Values include the kick-stage mass penalty and are spacecraft payload after that modeled penalty. Model scenarios, not confidence intervals or guarantees.
